mapper.select: SELECT files.ID id, files.JOB_ID jobId, files.JOB_SEQ jobSeq, files.PRODID prodid, files.PROD_NAME prodName, files.END_DATE endDate, files.START_DATE startDate, files.REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel, files.REVEAL_END_DATE revealEndDate, files.REP_TYPE rep_Type, files.REP_ID repId, files.REP_NAME repName, files.FILE_TYPE fileType, files.IS_CONFIRM isConfirm, files.IS_REVEAL isReveal, files.STATUS statu, info.TEMPLATE_ID templateId, info.TEMPLATE_PATH templatePath, info.TEMPLATE_NAME templateName, info.REPORT_NAME reportName, info.REPORT_TYPE reportType, info.REP_ORDER repOrder, info.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory FROM REP_INSTALL_FILE files LEFT JOIN REP_INFO info on files.REP_ID = info.REP_ID order by JOB_SEQ desc
SELECT SCREEN_KEY, SCREEN_NAME, SCREEN_TYPE, SCREEN_VALUE, SCREEN_STATUS FROM REP_SCREEN where REP_ID = #{repId} AND SCREEN_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY SCREEN_INDEX
mapper.update: update REP_INSTALL_FILE set EXEC_STATUS = #{execStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ID = #{id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update REP_INSTALL_LOG
JOB_ID = #{jobId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
JOB_NAME = #{jobName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
END_DATE = #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE},
START_DATE = #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE},
EXEC_DATE = #{execDate,jdbcType=DATE},
FLAG = #{flag,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
EXEC_DETAIL = #{execDetail,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
EXEC_STATUS = #{execStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
UPDATE_TIME = #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
where JOB_SEQ = #{jobSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
